messages:
Sam: Seeing a customer hit a sudden burst of 429s on /v1/generate around 00:02 UTC. Spike lasted ~90s.
Priya: Which tenant? any RPM/TPM numbers?
Sam: tenant: acct-83. Baseline ~120 RPM, spike peaked ~1.8k RPM, TPM stayed low-ish. Most responses were 429 with Retry-After: 2.
Matt: Can you paste a few response headers from the logs?
Sam: Copied from proxy logs:
```
status=429 path=/v1/generate tenant=acct-83 x-ratelimit-limit=600 x-ratelimit-remaining=0 x-ratelimit-reset=1699994402 retry-after=2
status=200 path=/v1/ping tenant=acct-83
status=429 path=/v1/generate tenant=acct-83 x-ratelimit-limit=600 x-ratelimit-remaining=0 retry-after=3
```
Priya: Hm — remaining=0 and quick resets. Looks like many very short-lived concurrent streams pushing token windows. Any SDK versions reported?
Sam: Customer on mobile SDK 0.9.1. They reported flaky mobile connectivity and keepalives enabled every 10s.
Matt: That rings a bell — SDK 0.9.x had a reconnect/heartbeat interaction bug where reconnects could spawn extra heartbeat timers on unstable networks. Those heartbeats are small requests but multiply across devices.
Priya: Repro steps I used locally: 1) enable heartbeat interval=10s 2) simulate intermittent network toggles (toggle airplane mode) 3) reconnect spawns duplicate heartbeats -> short burst of 50-200 requests in <1min.
Sam: CustomerSent: "We see 429s across our users at login time". They have ~200 devices concurrently connecting, each device doing 3 small requests during login + heartbeat.
EngOncall: Immediate mitigations:
- Ask customer to temporarily set heartbeat interval to 60s or disable while we patch.
- Apply a 15m soft quota bump for acct-83 from 600 RPM -> 2k RPM (manual override) to relieve current errors.
- Add a short-term gateway rule: limit concurrent streaming connections per tenant to 8.
Priya: Longer-term: release SDK hotfix to dedupe heartbeat timers and add jitter to heartbeat schedule on startup. Also update docs: recommend exponential reconnect backoff.
Sam: Message draft to send customer:
"Thanks — we found SDK heartbeat duplication under flaky networks. As a hotfix please set heartbeat interval=60s while we roll a patch. We've applied a temporary quota bump and enabled a short throttle to keep your app usable. Next steps: upgrade SDK when we ship the fix." :white_check_mark:
SupportBot: Created ticket RED-12345 and scheduled flare window for a temporary quota bump.
Matt: Quick gateway snippet to throttle concurrent streams per tenant (temporary):
```
# pseudo-config
tenant_concurrency_limit: 8
throttle_action: 429
```
Sam: Marking this for a post-incident doc. I'll attach traces and p99 latency slices once they're in. @EngOncall please own the follow-up. :eyes:
EngOncall: Got it — I'll collect traces, check batching stats, and add a remediation PR for the SDK fix. Will update thread with timeline and root cause analysis.
